title: Right Whale Recovery Grew, But Mothers Are The Bottleneck
hook: A fragile whale rebound ends at a surprisingly small maternal bottleneck.
closing: Protecting breeding mothers is essential if the right whale rebound is to continue.
question: Can the rebound keep growing?

segments.say: The right whale population reached 384 in 2024. The recovery is real but still numerically fragile.
The recent right whale season produced 22 calves. New births are the next step in that recovery.
Only 70 right whales are breeding females. The entire recovery ultimately depends on this small group.
